testcase.name: input-schema-not-object

failure.message: broken: The input schema is not a JSON Schema object of type "object".

testcase.failure: broken: The input schema is not a JSON Schema object of type "object". expected: inputSchema.type = "object" actual: inputSchema.type = undefined fix: Give the tool an inputSchema whose root has "type": "object" (a tool without parameters: {"type": "object", "additionalProperties": false}). spec: https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2025-11-25/schema#tool-inputschema

testcase.name: desc-missing

skipped.message: advisory: broken: The tool has no description.

testcase.skipped: broken: The tool has no description. expected: a description actual: none fix: Describe what the tool does, when to use it and when not to: the model chooses tools by name and description alone. The specification does not require a description; this is advice on quality. spec: https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2025-11-25/schema#tool-description

testcase.name: annotations-missing

skipped.message: advisory: broken: The tool has no annotations.

testcase.skipped: broken: The tool has no annotations. expected: annotations actual: none fix: Add annotations: readOnlyHint, destructiveHint, idempotentHint and openWorldHint tell a client what the tool may do. spec: https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2025-11-25/schema#tool-annotations
